shortdesc.ph: Captures the screen by specifying a display ID.
Captures the screen by specifying the display ID.

p.codeblock: virtual int startScreenCaptureByDisplayId(int64_t displayId, const Rectangle& regionRect, const ScreenCaptureParameters& captureParams) = 0;

section.note: This method is only applicable to Windows and macOS platforms.
section.p: Captures the video stream of a screen or a part of the screen area.

section.title: Timing
section.p:
You can call this method either before or after joining a channel. The differences are:
Call this method before joining the channel, then call joinChannel and set publishScreenTrack or publishSecondaryScreenTrack to to start screen sharing.
Call this method after joining the channel, then call and set publishScreenTrack or publishSecondaryScreenTrack to to start screen sharing.

plentry.pd: The ID of the screen to be shared. On Windows, to share both the primary and secondary screens simultaneously, set displayId to -1 when calling this method.
(Optional) The region relative to the screen to be shared. Pass to share the entire screen. See .

Screen sharing configuration. The default video resolution is 1920 × 1080 (2,073,600 pixels). Agora calculates costs based on this parameter. The video properties of the screen sharing stream should be set through this parameter and are not related to . See .

The display ID of the screen to be shared.For the Windows platform, if you need to simultaneously share two screens (main screen and secondary screen), you can set displayId to -1 when calling this method.

pd.ph: (Optional) Sets the relative location of the region to the screen. Pass in nil to share the entire screen.

ph.props: cpp unreal bp unity flutter cs

pd.ph: It consists of the following parameters:

ul.li: x: The horizontal offset from the top-left corner.
y: The vertical offset from the top-left corner.
width: The width of the region.
height: The height of the region.

plentry.pd: If the specified region overruns the screen, the SDK shares only the region within it; if you set width or height as 0, the SDK shares the whole screen.

Screen sharing configurations. The default video dimension is 1920 x 1080, that is, 2,073,600 pixels. Agora uses the value of this parameter to calculate the charges. See .The video properties of the screen sharing stream only need to be set through this parameter, and are unrelated to .

ul.li:
< 0: Failure.
-2: Invalid parameter.
-8: Invalid screen sharing state. This may occur if you are already sharing another screen or window. Call stopScreenCapture to stop the current sharing and try again.

< 0: Failure. See for details and resolution suggestions.
-2: The parameter is invalid.
-8: The screen sharing state is invalid. Probably because you have shared other screens or windows. Try calling to stop the current sharing and start sharing the screen again.
